newsitem.title: USA: Disney Channel hits 20 million subscribers.
newsitem.headline: Disney Channel hits 20 million subscribers.

text.p: The Disney Channel said Thursday it surpassed the 20 million subscriber mark, with the addition of its service in several major markets.

Disney said that in recent months the Disney Channel has been added to the expanded basic cable package or the tiered levels of service by major market affiliates in Atlanta and Tampa Bay, Florida as well as suburban Los Angeles.
"This is a great milestone for us and validation of the success of our hybrid strategy," Charles Nooney, senior vice president of sales and affiliate marketing for the Disney Channel said.
The strategy is based on enabling cable affiliates to offer the channel either as a pay service or with expanded basic service.
